title: Bindings registry index
description: The index (ADR-042) a bindings registry publishes (default: the gtme-bindings repository's index.json; GTME_REGISTRY overrides). `gtme adapters search` reads it; `gtme adapters add` installs an entry by its source ref. Verified entries are maintained in the registry repository and fixture-tested by its CI; community entries point at their authors' repositories and ship fixtures, which `adapters add` runs before installing. A process entry (ADR-063) is a prebuilt process adapter: one checksum-pinned archive per platform holding manifest.json and an executable run, verified tier only.

kind.description: ADR-063: binding (a binding.yaml directory) or process (a prebuilt process adapter, installed from assets).

path.description: Directory inside the repository holding binding.yaml and fixtures/ (for a process entry, the code the assets were built from).

ref.description: Tag or branch the entry was published at.

sha.description: Commit the ref resolved to when the index was generated.

sha256.description: Content hash of the binding directory; `adapters add` refuses a mismatch. Required for a binding entry; a process entry pins each asset instead.

release.description: Process entries: the release tag the assets were published at.

assets.description: Process entries (ADR-063): one .tar.gz per platform, holding manifest.json and an executable run at its root; `adapters add` refuses a sha256 mismatch.
